nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b and validates require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): validates require(b <= a) then c = a - b
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b and validates require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): validates require(b > 0) then c = a / b
